Blockhold · UI refinement

More room to breathe.
Everything in its place.

Smaller mobile build labels, balanced padding, aligned wave controls, and a calmer desktop interface that keeps the battlefield in view.

Uses Blockhold’s existing wood, gold and parchment palette.

A compact desktop build picker

Three columns replace the tall stack. The popup stays below the HUD; wave controls share one height and a centered disclosure arrow.

Consistent map cards

Aligned artwork, titles, descriptions and stats, with matching page margins and quieter borders.

Readable tower details

Upgrade first, grouped stats below, and room around each action.

A clearer pre-battle choice

Compact hero cards and difficulty options. Cancel remains reachable in shorter windows.

Mobile spacing, corrected

Build names and prices use 11px text with consistent inner padding. The 52px build buttons and 44px wave controls keep their tap area.

Checked at 900 × 600, 1280 × 720, 1440 × 900, 1920 × 1080 and 667 × 375 in Chromium. Includes hover previews, buying, dismissing panels, wave details and pause controls. Captures stage account access and a long planning countdown for inspection. Browser emulation does not replace physical-device testing.
